problem.title: Maximum Product of Two Elements in An Array

approaches.title: Single-pass tracking of the two largest values
approaches.summary: Scans the array once while maintaining the largest and second-largest elements, then returns their decremented product. Revision 2 expresses the same strategy with a functional fold instead of an explicit loop.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Tracks the two largest values in one pass using scalar variables and computes their decremented product.
Refactors the same one-pass tracking algorithm into an iterator fold, preserving its behavior and complexity.
